event_chain.summary: Merged customer records caused confirmation emails to go to wrong recipients

summary: German distribution grid operator EWE Netz sent confirmation emails for digitally submitted electricity meter readings to the wrong recipients. In rare configurations, different customer records had been technically merged, so a customer's confirmation email showed the meter readings and full address details of other customers (in one reported case, three neighbours in Wiefelstede). Customers alerted the company; it corrected the faulty links, changed the IT system, and EWE Netz and at least one customer reported the incident to Lower Saxony's data protection commissioner. The number potentially affected was in the mid three-digit range, with far fewer likely actually exposed.
